contract_checks.manifest_note: Legacy C13 retains its own authenticated preparation and no auxiliary inputs. C45 versus C43 requires the entire typed binding unchanged except main warmup 273 versus 261; exact primary and auxiliary metadata/content, original history start, evaluation window and declared feedback/session/price contracts remain fixed.

paired_buyhold_check.baseline: EX003/C0013 embedded buy_hold; only implementation bookkeeping IDs excluded

public_audit_coverage.basis: Every account must occur in a COMPUTED public diagnose_accounts result with exact ordered EvidenceRef sources; account loading does not repeat the economic audit.

method_sources.usage: Read-only methodology reference for economic-ID normalization and continuous-account annual/holding/frequency descriptions; no imports or private audit calls.

semantics.annual: Year-end equity divided by preceding year-end equity; initial cash only for first year.
semantics.holding: Fraction of positive-quantity bar and session-close observations; not elapsed-time exposure.
semantics.frequency: Authenticated closed-cycle counts in all complete 60-session windows; overlapping windows are not independent.
semantics.goals: Confirmed full-window economic and dual-frequency goals only; not robustness, selection, freezing or stage advancement.

limitations: Repeatedly seen development data, 2019-2025; not independent validation.
No holdout, new account replay, candidate registration or production access during analysis.
